title: Reproducibility materials for “Decision consequences of evaluating synthetic clinical-data suitability across stochastic realizations and hospitals”
description: Public analysis software, approved aggregate source data, final manuscript displays, display-reproduction scripts and fabricated tests for synthetic clinical-data suitability across stochastic realizations and hospitals. No patient-level clinical or evaluated synthetic data, fitted clinical models, restricted hospital-level derivatives or private resampling assets are distributed. Full clinical source reconstruction requires independently authorized database access and additional restricted dependencies.
